title: Excalibur | Eidolon Support
description: A non official compatibility pack between Excalibur and Eidolon : Repraised.
body:
This Texture pack Re textures all the mobs from the eidolon mod to better fit Excalibur.


See Gallery for the the textures.

Currently only incudes the mobs and a purple gem.

 

Best Used with Excalibur

And Requires Eidolon:Repraised

Optionally you could also use the following mod if you're on 1.21.1 since i plan to do textures for that too Eidolon:Edoni

Enjoy.
